messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: service=redwood-gpu-infer region=west2-a severity=high reason=CUDA_OOM_spike kv_prefetch_thundering -> PagerDuty page fired (PD-76543). See: https://pd.example/PD-76543

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered and routing to on-call. Escalation policy: gpu-infer-primary -> gpu-infer-backup. Incident start: 2025-11-03T02:04:16Z

devin: acked. I’m on it — will check pool west2-a, prefetch metrics and recent deploys.

oncall-bot: Ack recorded: devin at 2025-11-03T02:04:42Z. SLA impact: potential increased tail latency for embedded inference customers.

maya: quick FYI — alert spike coincides with increased kv-prefetch ops from model v2.3.3 rollout this morning. Could be a prefetch amplification.

devin: pulling k8s pod logs from pool-west2-a: `kubectl -n infer logs -l pool=west2-a --tail 200`

sofia: sending flamegraph trace from node gpu-47: `ssh gpu-47 'sudo cat /var/log/redwood/infer/alloc.log | tail -n 200'` -> shows repeated `CUBLAS_ALLOC` failures then retries.

devin: logs snippet:
```
2025-11-03T02:02:58Z infer[pid=4231] ERROR cuda: CUBLAS_ALLOC failed: out of memory
2025-11-03T02:03:01Z infer[pid=4231] WARN autoretry: retrying 3/5 after OOM
2025-11-03T02:03:05Z infer[pid=4231] ERROR prefetch: kv_prefetch queued=120 inflight=90
```

maya: looks like prefetch concurrency ballooned. On some nodes kv cache evictions didn't free memory fast enough -> OOM cascade. Rolling back v2.3.3 prefetch defaults would be one option.

devin: mitigation plan: 1) throttle kv-prefetch concurrency via feature-flag (ff-infer-kv-prefetch=low) 2) drain most aggressive pods from west2-a to low-traffic pools 3) enable fallback to smaller model-variant for heavy tails. Applying flag now.

ops-lead: please post commands and ETA. Customer comms? Any active customer errors?

sofia: customer error surface: ~8 users saw `runtime_error: CUDA OOM` in the last 12m, majority retries succeeded but higher latency. No major 5xx spike in HTTP logs yet.

devin: applying feature flag: `curl -XPOST https://config.redwood/api/flags/ff-infer-kv-prefetch -d '{"value":"low","env":"prod","target":"west2-a"}'` -> response 200. Throttle taking effect (propagating to agents). ETA 60s.

oncall-bot: Feature flag change recorded by devin. Rolling update triggered for agent proxy.

maya: beginning pod drain for the hottest nodes: `kubectl -n infer cordon gpu-47 && kubectl -n infer drain gpu-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=5m`

devin: started rebalancing: draining 3 pods from gpu-47 -> migration started.

sofia: monitoring mem pressure dashboards. Prefetch inflight down from 90 -> 35 in last 90s. OOM logs dropping.

devin: confirming: no new CUBLAS_ALLOC errors in last 2m on drained nodes. Latency tail improving.

ops-lead: nice work. Can we hold for 10m to validate before fully closing PD? Also please prepare postmortem notes: root cause hypothesis (prefetch concurrency + eviction lag), timeline, rollback and follow-ups.

maya: noted. I'll capture timing + config diff for v2.3.3 prefetch change. Also propose a circuit-breaker: max-prefetch-inflight per-node.

devin: handing off to maya for next 30m monitoring. I'll remain available if it re-escalates.

oncall-bot: Incident update: acknowledged by dev team, mitigation applied, symptoms subsided. PagerDuty: please hold escalation.

sofia: quick checklist for follow-ups: 1) add KV eviction metrics to alerts 2) add prefetch burst guard 3) run chaos test with prefetch at scale in staging.

ops-lead: agreed. Assigning follow-ups: maya (config postmortem), sofia (alert tuning), devin (runbook update).

devin: PD: resolving temporarily. If anything flares, re-open. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-76543 set to acknowledged -> status=mitigated by dev team at 2025-11-03T02:06:50Z.

maya: last check: no customer 5xx increase, tail latency back to baseline for top 95pct. I'll post a short incident summary in #incidents in 20m.

sofia: logging this thread into runbook draft: `rm -rf /tmp/oom-runbook || true; echo "kv-prefetch ring mitigation" > /tmp/oom-runbook/notes.txt`

devin: thanks team. Good catch on the kv-prefetch ring.

ops-lead: closing loop: if stable at +30m, we'll close PD and mark RCA in follow-ups.
